title: Pause a delivery during sending (v7 console)
text: To pause a delivery that is sending, open the delivery in the console. Click pause. The delivery pauses. If the delivery does not pause, pause the MTA. A paused delivery can be resumed. Pause, check, then resume the delivery sending.

title: Stop or pause an in-flight send (v8)
text: For a delivery already sending, use Stop in the delivery dashboard. Notify the market lead and record the reason in the incident log. Do not restart the MTA; that affects every market.

title: Quiet hours by market
text: Sending windows per market. Do not schedule a delivery outside 08:00 to 21:00 local time.

title: Incident log template
text: Record what happened, when it was detected, when it was contained and what you changed. Use the reason field for every stopped delivery.
